question: Is Phil Foden Manchester City's most valuable attacking player in 2023-24?

on_off_splits.delta_summary: Small PPG delta (+0.13) with a very thin without sample. City's structural strength absorbs his absence — unlike Rodri.

scout_notes.author: The Athletic — Sam Lee
scout_notes.summary: Foden's POTY season was driven by output efficiency in a free role behind Haaland. But irreplaceability is bounded — Bernardo and De Bruyne overlap functionally; Rodri's profile has no shadow.

manager_quotes.summary: Phil has matured into one of the world's best — but our team works because we have many of him in different ways.

dossier.context_notes: Foden won the FWA Footballer of the Year and PFA Player of the Year for 2023-24. The case explores whether award + output is the same as 'most valuable'; the on/off and squad-overlap evidence are weaker than for Rodri.

__note__: Investigator case — single subject with strong individual output but weak irreplaceability evidence. Designed to surface that completeness alone doesn't decide judgments.
